title: Request for Proposal – Mobile Application Redesign
executive_summary: GlobalTech Solutions seeks proposals from qualified vendors to redesign its existing customer‑facing mobile application (iOS and Android). The redesign will modernize the user experience, improve performance, add new features, and align the app with the organization’s brand and security standards. The selected vendor will work closely with GlobalTech’s product, design, and IT teams to deliver a high‑quality, scalable solution within a 24‑week timeframe.
project_objectives: Enhance user experience and visual design to increase engagement and retention
Improve app performance (load time <2 seconds, crash rate <0.5%)
Add new self‑service features such as in‑app support chat, push notifications, and biometric login
Ensure compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and industry‑specific security standards
Create a reusable component library for future enhancements
scope_of_work: Conduct discovery workshops and user research to validate redesign direction
Develop high‑fidelity UI/UX prototypes and obtain stakeholder approval
Implement front‑end development for iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) using a shared architecture (e.g., Flutter or React Native)
Integrate with existing back‑end APIs and implement new API endpoints where required
Perform security hardening, accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA), and performance optimization
Conduct unit, integration, UI, and regression testing across devices
Provide documentation, source code repository setup, and knowledge‑transfer sessions
Offer post‑launch support and bug‑fix warranty for 90 days
functional_requirements: User registration/login with email, social (Google, Apple) and biometric options
Personalized dashboard displaying account summary, recent activity, and recommended actions
In‑app messaging center with push notifications
Self‑service support chat integrated with third‑party chatbot
Search functionality with filters and sorting
Settings page for language, theme (light/dark), and notification preferences
Offline mode for read‑only content with sync on reconnection
technical_requirements: Development framework: Flutter 3.x or React Native 0.72 (vendor to propose)
State management: Bloc/Cubit (Flutter) or Redux (React Native)
API communication via RESTful JSON over HTTPS with OAuth 2.0
Backend integration with existing GraphQL endpoints where applicable
Automated CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps
Static code analysis (SonarQube) and security scanning (OWASP Dependency‑Check)
Support for Apple App Store and Google Play Store submission guidelines
Analytics integration with Firebase Analytics and custom event tracking
design_requirements: Adopt GlobalTech brand guidelines (color palette, typography, iconography)
Design system with reusable components and style guide
Responsive layouts for phone (5‑7" screens) and tablet (7‑10" screens)
Accessibility: minimum contrast ratios, screen‑reader support, adjustable text size
Prototype delivery in Figma with interactive flows
Provide assets in SVG, PNG (2x/3x) and font files
deliverables: High‑fidelity UI mockups and interactive Figma prototype
Source code repository (Git) with branch strategy
Fully functional iOS and Android app binaries (IPA, AAB)
Automated test suites and test coverage report
Post‑launch support plan and knowledge‑transfer materials
project_timeline: Week 1‑2: Kick‑off, discovery workshops, requirements validation
Week 3‑4: User research, personas, journey mapping
Week 5‑7: Wireframes and UI concepts, stakeholder review
Week 8‑10: High‑fidelity designs and design system creation
Week 11‑14: Development sprint 1 – core navigation, authentication, dashboard
Week 15‑17: Development sprint 2 – messaging, support chat, document handling
Week 18‑19: Development sprint 3 – settings, offline mode, analytics
Week 20‑21: Integration testing, security hardening, performance tuning
Week 23: Bug fixing, final polish, app store submission
submission_guidelines: Proposals must be submitted in PDF format via the GlobalTech procurement portal no later than 2026‑10‑31 17:00 GMT
Include a cover letter, vendor profile, relevant case studies (minimum 2), proposed team CVs, technical approach, project schedule, and cost breakdown
All pricing must be presented in USD and broken down by license, development effort, testing, and support
Provide a minimum of three (3) professional references with contact information
Electronic signatures are accepted; handwritten signatures are not required
vendor_evaluation_criteria: Understanding of requirements and proposed solution (20 %)
Relevant experience and case studies of mobile app redesigns (20 %)
Technical competence of proposed team (certifications, years of experience) (15 %)
Quality of design approach and adherence to UI/UX best practices (15 %)
Project schedule realism and resource allocation (10 %)
Reference checks and past client satisfaction (5 %)
budget_requirements: Breakdown: Discovery & design $45,000; Development $130,000; Testing $30,000; Deployment & App‑store fees $15,000; Post‑launch support (90 days) $30,000
terms_and_conditions: All deliverables become the sole property of GlobalTech Solutions upon full payment
Vendor must comply with GlobalTech’s Code of Conduct and Data Protection Policy
Confidentiality: Vendor shall sign a Non‑Disclosure Agreement prior to project start
Payments will be milestone‑based, net 30 days after invoice approval
Intellectual property: source code, designs, and documentation are licensed exclusively to GlobalTech
Vendor shall maintain insurance coverage (Professional Liability ≥ $1 M)
Any subcontractors must be pre‑approved in writing by GlobalTech
Dispute resolution governed by the laws of the State of New York, USA
